name: hello-api
description: Single responsibility: serve the fixed "Hello, World!" greeting to signed-in callers through one read operation; requests without a valid token are rejected at the gateway. Listens on the service port declared in workload.yaml. Stores nothing, has no database, and does not edit greetings, personalise them or expose a health endpoint.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Sign-in client; the gateway validates tokens issued for it before requests reach this service.
